philosophy.notes: The portfolio keeps the recruiter route model while following the selected yellow/black design system by default, with a new white theme available as a controlled alternate mode across Home, Case Studies, CV, Contact, and project pages.

hierarchy.notes: The CV page now uses a full eight-role timeline, ordered from Graphic Designer through Lead Technical Artist, with the current AILiveSim role open by default.

execution.notes: Shared CSS supports the expanded CV timeline with compact desktop nodes, tablet wrapping, and two-column mobile wrapping without changing the site visual system.

specificity.notes: The CV timeline reflects the user's supplied work history: Graphic Designer, Junior Motion Designer, 2D Motion Designer, 3D Motion Designer, Lead 3D Motion Designer, Senior 3D Artist, Senior Technical Artist, and Lead Technical Artist.

restraint.notes: Yellow remains the primary signal in both modes; dark mode keeps black surfaces with white borders, while white mode uses white canvas, black structure, muted grey texture, and restrained yellow selected states.
